The '''Bah'r Kilido''' were a species [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with long faces and thin limbs. Their noses and chins were studded with a pair of short tusks. [[Suppoon]] was a member of this species.
